skill.name: facebook-marketplace-listing-and-price-extractor
skill.description: Extract public Facebook Marketplace listings through an Apify Actor using keywords, locations, categories, or item URLs. Retrieve structured prices, listing details, and photo links.
skill.summary: Collect public Facebook Marketplace listings and prices as JSON through Apify.
skill.author: bolvein-firex

security_audit.summary: All 67 static findings are false positives involving documentation, JavaScript strings, expected configuration reads, or the documented Apify workflow. A separate privacy concern is the declared default copying of listing photos and seller avatars into Actor storage without explicit opt-in. No evidence found of malicious exfiltration or prompt injection in the reviewed files; the remote Actor implementation was not available for review.

remediation.issue: The input schema enables copying listing photos and seller avatars into Actor storage by default.
remediation.suggestion: Default rehostImages to false, require explicit opt-in, and document storage access, retention periods, and deletion procedures.

content.user_title: Extract Facebook Marketplace Listings and Prices
content.value_statement: Comparing public Facebook Marketplace listings manually takes time and produces inconsistent records. This skill uses an Apify Actor to collect structured listing data for review.
actual_capabilities: Submit keyword and location searches, category feeds, Marketplace URLs, or direct listing IDs to the documented Apify Actor.
Configure price ranges, search radius, condition, delivery method, listing age, availability, and result ordering through supported Actor inputs.
Request fast feed extraction or deep listing details, including descriptions, seller information, coordinates, and photo links where available.
Set global, per-source, and pagination limits, with optional deduplication across input sources.
Run synchronous requests with the bundled Node runner or use the documented asynchronous API workflow for larger jobs.
Return Actor dataset rows as JSON with declared fields for title, price, location, condition, listing status, and source links.
limitations: Requires an Apify token and billed Actor usage; the bundled local runner requires Node.js 18 or newer.
Only public listings are supported; access restrictions, missing fields, and Marketplace changes can limit results.
The runner outputs JSON only; CSV conversion and recurring schedules require separate tooling.
Scraping runs remotely; bundled files do not expose the Actor implementation or guarantee its current behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Small First Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to 25 public office chair listings in Austin, Texas. Disable image rehosting and return available titles, prices, locations, and source links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: collect a small public listing sample.

prompt_templates.title: Filter a Local Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to 50 public laptop listings in Seattle within 30 kilometers, priced from 200 to 700. Sort by price ascending and disable rehosting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: narrow results with price and location filters.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Specific Listings
prompt_templates.prompt: Fetch these public item URLs: [listing URLs]. Use deep mode with image rehosting disabled. Summarize available descriptions, condition, delivery options, and listing status.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: request details for known public items.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Bounded Multi-Source Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an asynchronous run for [public Marketplace URLs]. Deduplicate sources, cap results at 200 and pages per source at five, and disable rehosting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: configure a larger run without starting it automatically.

best_practices: Start with 25 items and review current Actor pricing before increasing result or pagination limits.
Keep APIFY_TOKEN in the environment, review input files before uploading, and exclude cookies, sessions, and private account data.
Disable image rehosting unless explicitly required; retain only necessary fields and check applicable site terms and privacy obligations.
anti_patterns: Do not provide private, login-protected, or paywalled sources, account cookies, or session credentials.
Do not treat asking prices as completed sale prices or assume missing fields confirm a listing attribute.
Do not use collected seller information for spam, harassment, or unlawful discrimination.

faq.question: What do I need to run this skill?
faq.answer: You need an Apify account and APIFY_TOKEN. The bundled runner requires Node.js 18 or newer; documented curl examples provide another route.

faq.question: Does this access private Facebook data?
faq.answer: No. The documented scope is public Marketplace listings without login, cookies, or sessions.

faq.question: Is extraction free?
faq.answer: Apify bills Actor usage to your account. Check the Actor pricing page before running.

faq.question: Can I export CSV directly?
faq.answer: The bundled runner returns JSON dataset rows. CSV conversion requires a separate export or transformation step.

faq.question: Will every listing include seller details and photos?
faq.answer: No. Deep mode requests additional details, but access restrictions and missing source data can leave fields unavailable.

faq.question: Are images copied, and how do large runs work?
faq.answer: The schema defaults image rehosting to true; disable it to avoid extra copies. Synchronous calls wait up to 300 seconds; larger runs use asynchronous requests.
